'''Mark DeMarko''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 GenCon Team Event]] on 8 August 1999 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d14">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99d14/ gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 20 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-team-tournament-milwaukee-wi-8-8-99d14/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
